name: BSP_Session_RouteMessage
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_unit_orders_apply, read-only analysis. void __thiscall(session = ECX, message = [esp+4], ...), body 0077C2A0..0077C469. Ghidra's pseudocode is wrong: it renders ECX as param_1 and the message as unaff_retaddr/unaff_EDI. Assembly 0077C2AB MOV EDI,ECX and 0077C2D0 MOV EBP,[ESP+18h] give the real binding. Requires game+5D4h >= 0Ah; derives routing flags from DAT_00E0AF1C and game+1FE4h, stamps msg+18h from sender+174h, sends to non-local peers through 00770B50 when hosting, and on the local bit calls 0076E520 to push the message into the session's own receive queue. 131 callers. docs/UNIT_STATE_MESSAGE.md | Packet cc2_session_dispatch read the whole body 0077C2A0..0077C469. Three destinations, chosen from the session mode at world+1FE4h (= session+F4h) and a flag word: bit 1 local through 0076E520 at 0077C44D, bit 2 to the host through 00779F90 at 0077C3B3 when the mode is 2, bit 4 to each peer of the list at entity+2A4h through 00770B50 at 0077C423 when the mode is 1. 0077C30A takes the caller override or the default 00E0AF1C; 0077C31D drops a word of exactly 4 outside a host session; 0077C333 forces the word to 1 when the mode is 0, so a local session delivers locally whatever the call site asked for. 0077C374's NEG/SBB/NEG/ADD 2 rewrites a client's peer bit to 3 or 2 and 0077C36B marks msg+1Ah for the host relay at 00780147. The addressee is the sender itself: msg+18h is always this->+174h. See docs/SESSION_MESSAGE_DISPATCH.md.

name: BSP_Entity_IssueCommand
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(entity, void* command, const TargetDescriptor* target, int flags), RET 0Ch at 0077d7ea, 47 callers. The gate at 0077d776 compares command+4h against [00e08f7c], which is the ordinal field of the attackmove command object 00e08f78. The AI-group call at 0077d7a7 gets the caller's descriptor, not the retargeted local copy. 007798d0 builds the message on the stack at [ESP+30h] and 0077c2a0 routes it with the flag override 0. All 47 call sites tabulated; every constant flags argument is 1, and 005252ed passes playerUnit->IsKindOf(18h) instead. docs/ENTITY_ORDER_MESSAGE.md | Run-time evidence, bsp_game.exe milestone 2l: 13 calls, one per Cruise record of usn_2_java.scn, each with flags 1 and a kind-0 descriptor.
